description: This is a PHP unit test class for the BuzzShare entity in the OrangeHRM application. It tests the creation and properties of BuzzShare objects within the Buzz plugin, including setup and database interaction.

classes.name: BuzzShareTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the BuzzShare entity, including properties like likes, comments, timestamps, and text content, within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and resets BuzzShare-related tables before each test run.

methods.name: testEntity
methods.description: Performs tests on the BuzzShare entity by creating an instance, setting properties, mocking the DateTimeHelperService, and asserting the correctness of the data.
